statement: {σ} (hσ : Rearrangement σ) (M : ℕ) : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, Finset.range M ⊆ Finset.image σ (Finset.range n)
name: EventuallyCovers_of_Rearrangement
content:
If `σ` is a `Rearrangement`, then for any `M`, there is an `N`, so that,
  for all `n ≥ N`, the `range M` is contained in `image σ (range n)`.
